title.narrative: Local Service Delivery for HIV/AIDS Activity

description.narrative: (Uganda): LSDA is implemented by the Uganda Protestant Medical Bureau (UPMB) and supports all the faith-based health facilities across the country. With FY 2022 TB funds, LSDA will support the following TB activities: 1) screening and detection of all forms of TB in infants, children, and adults at facility and community levels; 2) early initiation and completion of anti-TB treatment for all patients diagnosed with all forms of TB; 3) ensuring strong community systems to strengthen the continuum of TB prevention, screening, diagnosis, care, and treatment; and 4) improving the quality of the multi-drug resistant TB program and the TB/HIV collaborative activities via the implementation and scale-up of evidence-based community and facility interventions across the TB diagnostic, prevention, and treatment pathway. LSDA will also contribute to Health System Strengthening activities, including improved governance and coordination, commodities security and human resources for health.To ensure continuation of services during the COVID-19 pandemic, LSDA will integrate infection prevention and control activities and support targeted provision of personal protective equipment to protect service providers and beneficiaries of TB services. LSDA will fund activities to improve gender equality and empower women to access and use high quality health services and activities to mitigate the impact of climate induced disruptions to the delivery of health services.Health systems strengthening activities are jointly supported with PEPFAR (HIV) funds...
